kicker: Pareas, a compiler on the GPU

scenes.headline: How a GPU lexes text with a prefix scan
scenes.sub: Pareas turns a sequential state machine into map, scan and filter.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Nimbus! Pareas runs a compiler on the GPU, and its lexer does something that sounds impossible: a state machine, in parallel.

scenes.label: The trick
scenes.text: Don't carry a state, carry a function. Each byte becomes a transition function, and a prefix scan composes them in O(log n) steps.
scenes.say: The trick: don't carry a state, carry a function. Each byte becomes a transition function, and a parallel scan composes them all.

scenes.title: From a loop to a scan

left.title: Classic lexer
items: A loop over bytes, carrying a state
Each state needs the previous one
left.say: A classic lexer is a loop. Each state depends on the previous one, so n bytes take n steps in a row.

right.title: Pareas: carry a function
items: Each byte becomes a transition function
Composition is associative, so it can be scanned
right.say: Pareas carries functions instead. Composing functions is associative, so a parallel prefix scan finishes in log n steps.

scenes.title: The whole kernel: map, scan, filter

steps.say: First a map: every byte becomes the id of its transition function, one sixteen-bit number per byte.
Then a scan composes them. Every reachable composition was numbered ahead of time, so composing two is one lookup in a merge table.
The running result at each byte is the lexer's state there. A filter keeps the positions where a token ends.

scenes.title: Merge table size, by grammar
scenes.note: one block-comment rule: the generator runs out of memory
scenes.say: The catch: a string adds a mode, so a digit means one thing inside it and another outside. Functions stop collapsing, and the table explodes.

scenes.label: GPU over one simdjson thread on a 442 MB file, upload counted
scenes.note: 3.03× if the host-to-device upload is left out
scenes.say: The GPU still beats one simdjson thread on the largest file. Count the upload, and the margin is one point eight six times, not three.

scenes.text: The scan makes lexing parallel. The cost moves into the merge table, and it grows with the grammar.
scenes.say: The scan makes lexing parallel. But the cost moves into the merge table, and that grows with the grammar.

recap: Every byte becomes a transition function
A prefix scan composes them by table lookup
The k x k table is the real cost
scenes.say: To recap: bytes become functions, a scan composes them, and the merge table pays for it.
